#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool="$base/spool"
delivered="$base/delivered"
quarantine="$base/quarantine"
index="$delivered/index.tsv"
lock="$base/.replay.lock"

mkdir -p "$delivered" "$quarantine"
if ! mkdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "replay: another recovery is already running" >&2
    exit 1
fi
trap 'rmdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null || :' 0 1 2 3 15

if [ ! -s "$index" ]; then
    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$index"
fi

for message in "$spool"/*.eml; do
    [ -f "$message" ] || continue
    name=${message##*/}

    if message_id=$(awk '
        {
            line = $0
            sub(/\r$/, "", line)
            if (line == "")
                exit
            lower = tolower(line)
            if (lower ~ /^message-id:[ \t]*/) {
                sub(/^[^:]*:[ \t]*/, "", line)
                count++
                id = line
            }
        }
        END {
            if (count == 1 && id ~ /^<[^<> \t]+>$/) {
                print id
                exit 0
            }
            exit 1
        }
    ' "$message")
    then
        :
    else
        qtmp="$quarantine/.$name.tmp.$$"
        rtmp="$quarantine/.$name.reason.tmp.$$"
        cp "$message" "$qtmp"
        printf '%s\n' "Not replayed: missing, duplicate, or malformed Message-ID header." > "$rtmp"
        mv -f "$qtmp" "$quarantine/$name"
        mv -f "$rtmp" "$quarantine/$name.reason"
        continue
    fi

    if awk -F '\t' -v wanted="$message_id" '
        NR > 1 && $1 == wanted { found = 1 }
        END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }
    ' "$index"
    then
        continue
    fi

    destination=$name
    suffix=1
    while [ -e "$delivered/$destination" ]; do
        stem=${name%.eml}
        destination="$stem-$suffix.eml"
        suffix=$((suffix + 1))
    done

    tmp="$delivered/.$destination.tmp.$$"
    cp "$message" "$tmp"
    mv "$tmp" "$delivered/$destination"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$destination" >> "$index"
done
